transcript.text: Alright everyone, let's get this sign-off round started. Echo Chamber is scheduled to open to the public on Saturday, and I need to hear from each of our leads before I can approve the operating plan. To recap, the current draft allows 12 visitors per session, permits visitor photography, uses one general admission queue, and assigns one floor attendant. Could I have our technical, rights, accessibility, and risk leads each report any confirmed requirements they have? I'll go in order — technical first, then rights, then accessibility, then risk. Please go ahead.

transcript.text: I have a confirmed accessibility requirement to report. After yesterday's rehearsal, I confirmed with the access consultant that Echo Chamber must offer two low-sensory sessions daily, at exactly 2:00 PM and 6:00 PM, with each session lasting 20 minutes. This confirmation arrived after the draft schedule was circulated, so it is not yet reflected on the public timetable. The current draft plan does not include these low-sensory sessions, so the schedule will need to be updated before opening.

transcript.text: I have a confirmed risk requirement to report. I received the insurer's signed endorsement today, and it requires that every public session of Echo Chamber have 2 trained floor attendants present and that every visitor sign a participant waiver before entry. I have the endorsement in the risk file, but the current staffing roster and ticketing instructions still reflect the draft plan, which only assigns one floor attendant and does not include a waiver requirement.
